judgments.reason: The transthoracic echocardiogram finding 'diffuse medium masses in the right atrium' appears literally in the vignette and directly supports right atrial localization of the cardiac lymphoma.

The PET-CT finding 'significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports right atrial involvement as part of the diagnosis.
